Author: Nainaiowo
Name: Better Deaths
Description: Records party deaths with pull grouping, fatal events, active statuses, and recent action timelines.
Changelog:
Party Cooldown Fixes
- Replaced indirect party-row matching with the game's direct player-to-row mapping, including reordered party lists.
- Moved cooldown icons to the foreground draw layer to prevent other plugin windows from covering them.
- Added rate-limited diagnostics when cooldown tracking or the live overlay cannot update or display.

Tempera Fixes
- Native shield callbacks no longer depend on the optional packet timestamp hook.
- Shield-break reductions still require a matching incoming damage result and a living shield owner. Natural expiry, conversion alone, and death do not authorize a reduction.
- Preserved the DPS parser's existing status-timing requirements.
